entities.summary: The denomination Upper Rhenish Master refers to an artist active ca. 1410–20 possibly in Strasbourg. The most famous painting of the artist is Paradiesgärtlein, a mixed-technique painting on oakwood, 26.3 x 33.4 cm, now in the Städel Museum. The painting is the Städel's most famous example of the old German school.
